title: Fork
description: Relationship record created when a new execution run starts from an existing checkpoint, preserving the provenance of the new branch.

fork_of.description: Identifier of the existing run from which the new run branches. This corresponds to the checkpoint's parent_run_id.

new_run_id.description: Identifier assigned to the newly created execution run.

checkpoint_id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint from which the new run starts.

reason.description: Human- or machine-readable reason for creating the fork.

timestamp.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the forked run was created.
